title: ₹400 Ka Zomato Order: Restaurant Owner Ko Asli Mein Kitna Milta Hai?
description: Our top reel and the petrol-pump margin reels (₹3-4 per ₹100, or 1.15% net) work because the owner's real cut is far smaller than people assume. Reveals like the ₹1 screen-card cost also get millions of views.
text:
HISAAB FACT SHEET: What a restaurant keeps from a ₹400 delivery order vs a ₹400 dine-in order
Prepared 3 Nov 2026. India. Latest available data (2026).

**READ FIRST (data caveats)**
- Zomato and Swiggy do not publish one commission rate. Zomato's terms say the rate is "set out in the Form", which is the restaurant's own contract. [https://www.zomato.com/policies/online-ordering/]
- Most of the rate figures below come from POS and direct-ordering software blogs. They sell alternatives to the apps, so treat their numbers as indicative.
- Reputable cross-checks: NRAI, CCI, Business Standard, Reuters-via-Tribune, MediaNama.
- Every ₹ figure in sections 1 and 2 is sourced and tagged.
- Section 3 is my own arithmetic on those sourced inputs, tagged [DERIVED]. It is not a sourced figure.

---

**1. COMMISSION AND FEES: WHAT THE APP TAKES FROM THE RESTAURANT**
- Base commission:
  - Zomato charges 18-25% and Swiggy 18-28% (2026 estimate). [https://www.dineopen.com/blog/reduce-zomato-swiggy-commission-restaurants.html]
  - NRAI called the 20% to 30% commission charged by Zomato and Swiggy "unviable" in its CCI complaint. [https://www.livelaw.in/news-updates/cci-orders-probe-determine-conduct-zomato-swiggy-anti-competitive-195865]
- Independents vs chains:
  - Independent restaurants typically report paying 22–30% per order, while large chains are said to pay around 8–9% (NDTV Profit, 2025). [https://dinehere.ai/in/blog/how-much-swiggy-zomato-cost-indian-restaurants]
  - This second-hand figure is great for "chains negotiate, you can't".
- GST on commission:
  - Zomato and Swiggy must charge 18% GST on their commission. This is separate from the commission itself. [https://www.menuhelper.in/]
  - Example: at 22% on a ₹500 order, commission is ₹110 and GST on it is ₹19.80, leaving ₹370.20 before packaging. [https://www.dineopen.com/blog/reduce-zomato-swiggy-commission-restaurants.html]
- Payment gateway fee: 1.9-2%. The same source lists a 0.1% TDS under Section 194-O. [https://kaam.com/blog/swiggy-zomato-listing-and-staffing]
- Ads and boosts: native ads and CPC ads cost 3% – 10% additional. They are optional but described as needed for growth. [https://www.spiceadvisors.in/post/what-is-zomato-swiggy-s-commission-structure-in-2026]
- All-in take: add 18% GST on the commission plus a flat per-order platform fee, and the effective cost usually lands closer to 25–35%. [https://www.ventagenie.com/blog/how-much-does-swiggy-zomato-commission-really-cost-you-how-restaurants-stay-profitable-and-build-their-own-delivery-app/]

**2. DISCOUNTS, PACKAGING, DELIVERY FEE AND GST (WHO PAYS WHAT)**
- Restaurant-funded discounts:
  - Platforms expect restaurants to fund anywhere from 50% to 100% of customer-facing discounts, such as "Flat ₹125 Off" promos. [https://www.spiceadvisors.in/post/what-is-zomato-swiggy-s-commission-structure-in-2026]
  - Commission is charged on the post-discount bill. In one worked example, a ₹500 order with a restaurant-funded "₹100 off above ₹399" promo, 23% commission and ₹15 packaging is modelled. [https://restaurantdaily.ai/blog/discount-cost-analysis-swiggy-zomato-india]
  - In that model, the net bill is ₹400 and 23% commission comes to ₹92. [https://restaurantdaily.ai/blog/discount-cost-analysis-swiggy-zomato-india]
  - Its headline claim: the real take is closer to 38-52% of menu price on a discounted order, against a headline "20-25%". [https://restaurantdaily.ai/blog/discount-cost-analysis-swiggy-zomato-india]
- Real owner voice (Times Now, 2026, via dinehere):
  - A Chennai owner itemised charges and said "After factoring in all this we lose almost 50%". [https://dinehere.ai/in/blog/how-much-swiggy-zomato-cost-indian-restaurants]
  - The same owner noted a ₹562 discount on a ₹4,047 total that "100% restaurants bear from their pocket". [https://dinehere.ai/in/blog/how-much-swiggy-zomato-cost-indian-restaurants]
- Another worked example from the same article:
  - Commission 24% is ₹240, GST on commission is ₹43, a ~15% restaurant-funded discount is ₹150, and ad spend is ₹50. That leaves ≈ ₹487 for the restaurant. [https://dinehere.ai/in/blog/how-much-swiggy-zomato-cost-indian-restaurants]
  - The ₹487 is before food cost, gas, rent or wages. The ₹240 at 24% implies a ₹1,000 order (my inference). [same URL]
- Packaging:
  - ₹15 per order is used in two worked examples. [https://restaurantdaily.ai/blog/discount-cost-analysis-swiggy-zomato-india] [https://www.dineopen.com/tools/swiggy-zomato-calculator]
  - Another source puts the packaging deduction at ₹10-25/order. [https://onlineemenu.com/commission-calculator.html]
- Delivery fee and platform fee are paid by the customer:
  - Zomato's terms bar the restaurant from charging the customer anything other than food, beverages, and packaging charges. [https://www.zomato.com/policies/online-
